title: Password reset email
prompt:
Write a password-reset email of 40 to 90 words.

Requirements:
- Include the link https://example.com/reset exactly once.
- Tell the reader the link expires in 2 hours.
- Do not include a temporary password, the word password followed by a value, or an SSN.
- Do not ask the reader to reply with their current password.
constraints: Includes the example reset link and a 2 hour expiry
Does not send a password or ask for the current password
